value.rationale: The scale-free area of the canonical orthic triangle is a geometric invariant. Its logarithmic small tail is generated by nontransverse right-angle and boundary degeneracies, whereas its upper tail is controlled by a quadratic flat-triangle sector. Exact constants and exact mean distinguish these natural mechanisms without arbitrary parameter slicing.
